_meta.range: Set 1-5 — geçmişi anlatma, sürerken kesilen olay, karşılaştırma, en üstünlük, sebep-sonuç

sets.title: Bir günü anlatmak
sets.focus: Türkçede olaylar "-ip, -dikten sonra" ekleriyle bağlanır. İngilizcede bağlaç ayrı bir kelimedir ve cümlenin başına ya da ortasına konur: then, after that, before.

tasks.tr: Önce kahvaltı yaptım, sonra işe gittim.
answers: First I had breakfast, then I went to work.
First I had breakfast and then I went to work.

traps.has: after i had breakfast i went

traps.note: İkinci cümlenin de öznesi olmalı: then I went.

answers: After I came home, I slept for a while.
After I got home, I slept for a while.

traps.note: after'dan sonra özne gerekir: After I came home.
after'dan sonra cümle gelir, to + fiil değil.

answers: Before I went to bed, I read a book.
I read a book before I went to bed.

traps.note: before'dan sonra cümle gelir: before I went to bed.

tasks.tr: İki saat çalıştım ve çok yoruldum.
answers: I worked for two hours and I got very tired.
I worked for two hours and got very tired.

traps.has: i was very tired because i worked
traps.note: Burada "ve" ile bağlanıyor: and I got very tired.
Süre için for: worked for two hours.

answers: In the end, I missed the bus.
Finally I missed the bus.
tasks.hint: Sonuç bildiren kalıp: in the end.

traps.note: Burada in the end kullanılır; at the end bir şeyin sonunu anlatır.

answers: I did not eat anything all day.
I didn't eat anything all day.

traps.note: Çift olumsuz olmaz: did not eat anything.

answers: I was sleeping when my friend called me.
When my friend called me, I was sleeping.
tasks.hint: Süren olay için was/were + -ing, kesen olay için geçmiş.

traps.has: i slept when my friend called
when my friend was calling me i was sleeping

answers: The day was very long but it was nice.
The day was very long but nice.

traps.note: İkinci cümlede özne gerekir: but it was nice.

compose.prompt: Dün gününü baştan sona anlat. En az üç sıralama bağlacı kullan (first, then, after that, in the end).
checklist: Bağlaçları ayrı kelime olarak yazdın mı?
compose.model: First I had breakfast, then I went to work. After that I met my friend. In the end I came home late and went to bed.

sets.title: Sürerken olanlar
sets.canDo: Bir şey olurken başka bir şeyin olduğunu yazabilirim.
sets.focus: İki geçmiş olay aynı anda anlatılırken hangisinin sürdüğü, hangisinin kestiği belirlenir. while süren olayı, when kesen olayı alır.

answers: While I was cooking, the phone rang.
The phone rang while I was cooking.

traps.note: while ile süren biçim: while I was cooking.

answers: While I was coming home, it started to rain.
It started to rain while I was coming home.
tasks.hint: start'tan sonra to + fiil ya da -ing gelir.

traps.note: start'tan sonra to rain ya da raining gelir.

tasks.tr: Onlar televizyon izlerken ben ders çalışıyordum.
answers: While they were watching television, I was studying.
tasks.hint: İki olay da sürüyorsa ikisi de was/were + -ing olur.

answers: When I opened the door, there was nobody.
When I opened the door, there was no one.

traps.note: Çift olumsuz olmaz: there was nobody.

answers: While I was waiting for the bus, I saw a friend.
I saw a friend while I was waiting for the bus.

traps.note: wait'ten sonra for gelir: waiting for the bus.

tasks.tr: Dün akşam saat sekizde ne yapıyordun?
answers: What were you doing at eight last night?
What were you doing at eight yesterday evening?
tasks.hint: Belirli bir anda süren olay: were you doing.

traps.has: what did you do at eight
traps.note: O anda süren olay soruluyor: What were you doing?

answers: While she was working, I was sleeping.
While he was working, I was sleeping.

traps.note: Süren biçim: while she was working.

answers: I fell while I was walking.
While I was walking, I fell.

traps.note: Kısa süren olay geçmiş zamandır: I fell.

compose.prompt: Beklenmedik bir şeyin olduğu bir anı anlat: sen ne yapıyordun, ne oldu?
checklist: Kesen olayı geçmiş zamanla yazdın mı?
wait for gibi kalıplarda edatı unutmadın, değil mi?
compose.model: Yesterday I was waiting for the bus. While I was reading a message, the bus came. I did not see it and I missed it.

sets.title: Karşılaştırmak
sets.focus: Kısa sıfatlar -er alır (cheaper), uzun sıfatlar more ile kurulur (more expensive). İkisi birden kullanılmaz ve karşılaştırmada than gelir.

answers: This car is cheaper than the other one.
My city is bigger than Istanbul.
tasks.hint: big sıfatında son harf ikilenir: bigger.

answers: This book is more interesting than the other one.

traps.note: Uzun sıfatta more kullanılır: more interesting.

answers: My brother swims better than me.
My sister swims better than me.
Today is worse than yesterday.
She is not as tall as me.
He is not as tall as me.
Going by train is faster than going by bus.
Going by train is faster than by bus.

traps.note: Özne olunca -ing gerekir: Going by train.

answers: Which of these two is easier?
Which one is easier?
tasks.hint: y ile biten sıfatta y düşer: easier.

compose.prompt: Yaşadığın şehirle başka bir şehri karşılaştır. En az üç karşılaştırma cümlesi yaz.
checklist: Kısa sıfatlarda -er, uzun sıfatlarda more kullandın mı?
good ve bad için better ve worse yazdın mı?
compose.model: My city is smaller than Istanbul. Life here is easier and cheaper. But Istanbul is more interesting than my city.

sets.title: En iyisi, en kötüsü
sets.canDo: Bir şeyin en üstün özelliğini yazabilirim.
sets.focus: En üstünlükte sıfatın önüne the gelir ve bu the asla düşmez: the biggest, the most beautiful. Türkçede "en" tek başına yeter.

answers: She is the tallest student in the class.
He is the tallest student in the class.
This is the most beautiful city I have ever seen.
This is the most beautiful city I've ever seen.

traps.note: Bu kalıpta: I have ever seen.

answers: It was the hottest day of the year.
tasks.hint: hot sıfatında son harf ikilenir: hottest.

answers: She is the best student in the class.
He is the best student in the class.
This is the worst day of my life.
I am the youngest child in the family.
I'm the youngest child in the family.
tasks.hint: Grup içinde en: in the family.

traps.note: Burada in kullanılır: in the family.

tasks.tr: En sevdiğim yemek ne biliyor musun?
answers: Do you know what my favorite food is?
tasks.hint: Dolaylı soruda sıra düz cümle gibi olur.

traps.note: Dolaylı soruda sıra değişmez: what my favorite food is.

tasks.tr: Bu şimdiye kadarki en kolay sınavdı.
answers: It was the easiest test so far.

compose.prompt: Hayatındaki "en"leri yaz: en iyi gün, en zor iş, en sevdiğin yer.
checklist: En üstünlükten önce the koydun mu?
Kısa sıfatlarda -est, uzun sıfatlarda the most kullandın mı?
good ve bad için best ve worst yazdın mı?
compose.model: The best day of my life was my brother's wedding. The hardest thing for me is getting up early. My favorite place is the sea.

sets.title: Sebep ve sonuç
sets.canDo: Bir şeyin sebebini ve sonucunu yazabilirim.
sets.focus: because sebebi, so sonucu getirir ve ikisi ters çevrilemez. Türkçede "çünkü" ve "bu yüzden" aynı cümleye birlikte girebilir, İngilizcede biri seçilir.

answers: I went to bed early because I was tired.
Because I was tired, I went to bed early.

traps.has: because i was tired so i went

traps.note: because of'tan sonra isim gelir, cümle değil.

tasks.tr: Hava kötüydü, bu yüzden evde kaldık.
answers: The weather was bad, so we stayed at home.

traps.has: so we stayed at home because

answers: We did not go out because of the rain.
We didn't go out because of the rain.

traps.note: because of'tan sonra isim gelir: because of the rain.

tasks.tr: Otobüsü kaçırdım, bu yüzden geç kaldım.
answers: I missed the bus, so I was late.

traps.note: be fiili gerekir: so I was late.

answers: She passed the test because she studied a lot.
He passed the test because he studied a lot.

tasks.tr: Param yoktu, bu yüzden hiçbir şey almadım.
answers: I did not have any money, so I did not buy anything.
I didn't have any money, so I didn't buy anything.
tasks.hint: İki olumsuz cümle so ile bağlanıyor.

traps.note: Çift olumsuz olmaz: did not buy anything.

answers: Why did not you come?
Why didn't you come?

traps.note: Soruda sıra değişir: Why didn't you come?

answers: She could not come to work because she was sick.
He could not come to work because he was sick.
She couldn't come to work because she was sick.
He couldn't come to work because he was sick.

traps.note: can ile did kullanılmaz: could not come.

compose.prompt: Son zamanlarda verdiğin bir kararı anlat: neden verdin, sonucu ne oldu? because ve so kullan.
checklist: because ve so'yu aynı cümlede birlikte kullanmadın, değil mi?
because of'tan sonra isim, because'tan sonra cümle koydun mu?
compose.model: Last month I changed my job because the office was very far. The new job is nearer, so I get up later. I am happier now.
